text:
Alex: FYI CI is failing on the new kernel artifacts — size exceeded the artifact quota and the fatbin contains PTX for every arch.
Priya: ugh, I saw that. The fatbin approach was easiest for runtime fallback but it balloons to ~220MB.
Jonathan: Can you paste the nvcc flags used in the job?
Alex: Here:```nvcc -O3 -arch=sm_80 -gencode=arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 \
  -gencode=arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 \
  -gencode=arch=compute_90,code=sm_90 \
  -Xptxas -v -lineinfo -Xcompiler -fPIC -DNDEBUG -shared -o libkernels.so```
Mike: That's the problem — including PTX for all compute_XX entries means the fatbin embeds PTX and cubin for each arch. Good for portability but huge.
Priya: We need a CI-friendly tradeoff: either split artifacts per arch (one cubin per smX) or generate only cubins for the minimum supported arch and ship PTX only for one higher arch for JIT fallback.
Jonathan: Splitting reduces per-artifact size but increases number of uploads and matrix jobs. CI time will go up unless we parallelize.
Alex: The failing pipeline uses a single runner with 10GB artifact limit, so multiple 60MB files would still fit. The problem is the single lib that contains everything.
CI Bot: build-main: FAILED — artifact size 212.3MB exceeds quota 200MB. Logs at https://ci.internal/build/6789
Mike: Options: 1) Change nvcc to use -gencode=arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 -gencode=arch=compute_86,code=compute_86 (emit PTX for one arch), 2) Build per-target with -arch=sm_XX to produce cubin-only libraries, 3) Strip and LTO later.
Priya: For option 1, example:```-gencode=arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 
-gencode=arch=compute_86,code=compute_86```makes the 86 entry PTX-only, right? That keeps runtime JIT for newer GPUs but smaller binary.
Jonathan: Right. Also consider adding `-Xcompiler -ffunction-sections -Xlinker --gc-sections` on the host link stage and `-Xcompiler -fdata-sections` to remove unused symbols. That trimmed ~12% for us previously.
Alex: We should add a CI size gate that can be bumped per branch with a comment and a link to RFC PR. For now, quick fix: switch CI job to split artifacts by arch to unblock.
Mike: I'll prototype a helper script to build matrix and upload a single tarball with per-arch sublibs so downloads are still one artifact but internal size per file is smaller. Also add `strip --strip-unneeded` and `cuobjdump -ptx` sanity check.
Priya: Also watch out for -maxrregcount X on nvcc tests — limiting regs hurts perf badly on some kernels. Keep that off in CI perf builds.
Jonathan: Agreed. Perf builds (nightly) should be full feature; PRs use size-optimized builds.
Alex: Can we add a quick checklist to the RFC follow-up? Items: 1) default gencode policy, 2) CI artifact strategy (split vs fatbin), 3) size gate thresholds, 4) link-time stripping steps, 5) docs for kernel authors.
Mike: Will open a small PR to change the PR pipeline to per-arch build + tarball and a follow-up to add strip flags.
Priya: Thanks. If someone runs into local JIT missing kernel error, remind to install CUDA toolkit matching the PTX tier or run the tarball that includes cubin for their GPU.
Alex: OK closing — Mike please ping when the PR is up and we can relax the size gate after it lands. :thumbsup:
Mike: will do. :white_check_mark:
CI Bot: comment: PR 3456 created to split artifacts (https://ci.internal/pr/3456)
